meta.description: Position-specific intel for team needs generation. Add entries here when news breaks — injuries, FA departures, trades, scheme changes. The build script uses this to generate contextual notes under each positional need.
meta.usage: Each team has an array of intel entries. Each entry has: pos (position abbr), type (injury/free_agency/contract/depth/coaching/trade/news), and note (the context).

LV.note: No franchise QB since Gannon era. First R1 QB since JaMarcus Russell (2007).
Kolton Miller aging, pass protection struggled all season.
Nate Hobbs entering contract year. Secondary needs youth.

NYJ.note: NFL-record 0 interceptions in 2025. Need a true franchise signal-caller.
Need a contested-catch alpha WR to complement the passing game.
D.J. Reed entering final year. Sauce Gardner traded to Jaguars.
Haason Reddick departed. Pass rush needs rebuilding.

ARI.note: Allowed 53 sacks in 2025 (6th-most). OL rebuild is top priority.
James Conner aging. Need a workhorse back for LaFleur's zone scheme.
Need a bendy rusher off the edge to complement Darius Robinson.

TEN.note: Building around Cam Ward. Desperately need weapons for young QB.
Kevin Zeitler headed to FA. Interior line needs reinforcement.
Saleh's Wide-9 demands press-man corners. Current CBs don't fit.

NYG.note: Secondary has been a liability. Deonte Banks inconsistent.
Need explosive pass rusher to pair with Brian Burns.
Wan'Dale Robinson is a FA. Need playmakers around Malik Nabers.

CLE.note: QB room unsettled with Gabriel/Sanders. Monken needs a passer.
Dawand Jones struggled. Need a mauler to protect the QB.
Need sideline-to-sideline LB to replace Schwartz-era scheme losses.

WAS.note: Must protect Jayden Daniels after injury-plagued season.
Secondary burned regularly. Need a technical corner.
Pass rush disappeared in big games. Need a speed rusher.

NO.note: Need a field stretcher to take the top off defenses for Shough.
Blindside protection a concern. Need a mauler at tackle.
Cameron Jordan nearing retirement. Need a power rusher to replace him.

KC.note: Travis Kelce era ending (likely retirement). Massive hole at TE.
Need an athletic tackle to match Mahomes' extending-play style.
Need a YAC monster to complement the short passing game.

CIN.note: OL remains priority around Burrow. Highest pick since Ja'Marr Chase.
Interior line gave up too much pressure. Road grader needed.
Defensive line needs an anchor against the run.

MIA.note: Tua's future uncertain. Hafley rebuilding from ground up.
Shanahan concepts demand athletic tackles. Current OTs don't fit.
Need a two-gap nose to anchor Duggan's Cover 3 front.

DAL.note: Defense allowed most points in franchise history (~30 PPG).
Need a technical pass rusher to complement Quinnen Williams trade.
Box safety needed for Parker's Fangio Two-High scheme.

LAR.note: Cobie Durant and Ahkello Witherspoon headed to FA.
Need a speed rusher to generate pressure.
Stafford returning for 2026 but successor planning needed.

BAL.note: Need a contested-catch WR to help Lamar in the red zone.
4th-lowest pressure rate in NFL. Need a power rusher.
Man-press corner needed for Weaver's disguised looks.
Linderbaum FA bound (no 5th-year option). May lose star center.

TB.note: Lavonte David turns 36, likely last season. 15th year with Bucs if he returns.
Need a long-arm rusher to generate consistent pressure.
Tristan Wirfs moved inside. Tackle spot needs an anchor.

DET.note: Frank Ragnow retired (failed comeback physical). Center is a crisis.
Taylor Decker considering retirement. Glasgow struggled at C (56.8 PFF).
Need a speed rusher in Sheppard's attacking 4-3.

MIN.note: Ryan Kelly likely retiring (3 concussions in 2025). Center need is critical.
Harrison Smith retiring at 37. Era-defining safety leaving a void.
Need a technical corner to hold up in Flores' exotic pressures.

CAR.note: Center position and OL depth are top priorities.
Need a 3-tech penetrator. Defensive interior is thin.
FA holes threaten all three levels of defense.

PIT.note: Aaron Rodgers not returning. 9th straight year without playoff win.
Need a contested-catch WR to be the alpha target.
Zone corner needed for Graham's multiple front scheme.

LAC.note: Slater and Alt injuries killed OL (47.6 pass-block grade, worst in NFL).
Need an inline blocker for McDaniel's zone scheme.
Need a penetrator up front to complement the pass rush.

PHI.note: Coverage breakdowns plagued secondary all season.
Need a bendy rusher for Fangio's two-high scheme.
Coverage LB needed. Goedert, Phillips, Blankenship among FAs.

CHI.note: Ozzy Trapilo (LT) out 6-12 months with patellar tendon injury.
29th in pressure rate in 2025. Pass rush is nonexistent.
Brisker and Byard both FAs. Safety room gutted.
Need a zone blocker for Ben Johnson's Erhardt-Perkins system.
Need a penetrating 3-tech to collapse the pocket.

BUF.note: Need contested-catch weapons around Josh Allen.
Need a two-gap DL to anchor Leonhard's quarters scheme.
Need a sideline-to-sideline LB to cover the middle.

SF.note: Aiyuk being released. Jennings is FA. WR room decimated.
Bosa and Williams both tore ACLs. Dead last in sacks (20).
Need a zone blocker for Shanahan's outside zone concepts.

HOU.note: Joe Mixon missed entire 2025 (foot, NFI). Marks/Chubb filled in.
Interior OL remains weak. Need a pivot for Shanahan concepts.
Need a hybrid safety for Burke's attacking front.

NE.note: Drake Maye breakout season but needs more weapons around him.
Need an athletic tackle to protect the franchise QB.
Need a power rusher to complement the dominant defense.

DEN.note: Need a sideline-to-sideline LB in Vance Joseph's 3-4.
Need a two-gap DL to hold the point of attack.
Need a seam stretcher for Payton's West Coast passing game.

SEA.note: Kubiak leaving for Raiders HC. Interior OL needs a mauler.
Need a technician at tackle. Protection broke down in playoffs.
Need an explosive edge rusher in Durde's 3-4.

IND.note: Gus Bradley left for Titans DC. Need press-man corners for replacement scheme.
Need a centerfield safety to anchor the back end.
Speed rusher needed to generate pressure off the edge.

ATL.note: Need a YAC monster for Stefanski's wide zone play-action game.
Need a penetrating DT. Ulbrich generated franchise-record 57 sacks but DL aging.
Need a move TE for Rees' play-calling concepts.

GB.note: DT unit ranked 31st in PFF run-defense grade (30.6). Run defense terrible.
Need a thumper LB. 4th-most rushing yards allowed between tackles.
Need a ballhawk safety for Gannon's quarters coverage.

JAX.note: Need a man-press corner after acquiring Sauce Gardner (scheme fit matters).
Need a ballhawk safety to complement the secondary.
Looking for depth pieces. Contender filling gaps.
